NOT CONFORMED — the `Add token` Badge (333:2348), and this is the finding:
the badge labels a state that in code is a MODAL. `AddTokenModal` renders
`position:absolute; inset:0` with a 50%-black scrim over the whole panel
(AddTokenModal.tsx:45-55), so a pill sitting on the list behind it can never
be seen by anyone. Shipping it would add chrome whose only observable
property is that it is covered.
The badge is real elsewhere in this family and does ship — Draft preset,
Starter applied, Warnings suppressed, Exported, Imported tokens — because
each of those labels a state of the SCREEN. `Add token` labels a state of an
overlay ON that screen, which the overlay already announces with its own
title ("Add color token").
Also note where the board puts it: y=83, in the band under the back row.
Its twin on 306:2080 sits at y=59, INSIDE the back row it would overlap.
Two instances of one component placed 24px apart on the same layout is the
signature of an annotation, not a component in flow.
Founder call to overrule; it is a two-line change in SectionStatusBadge and
one condition in DesignSystemTab.
